license_note: The Hugging Face repository ships no separate LICENSE file, but the OpenBMB/MiniCPM GitHub repository, which is the first-party home of the family, carries the full Apache-2.0 license text, and the model card declares Apache-2.0.

license_evidence.scope: MiniCPM5-1B weights and checkpoints under the OpenBMB Apache-2.0 family license

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniCPM5-1B weight release, the first checkpoint of the MiniCPM5 series. The MiniCPM3 and MiniCPM4 generations, later MiniCPM5 checkpoints, quantized and GGUF variants, and hosted services are separate boundaries.
strengths: Genuine new family checkpoint, light and on-device oriented with a hybrid reasoning mode
Apache-2.0 grant backed by the first-party OpenBMB/MiniCPM repository license text
tradeoffs: The Hugging Face repository ships no LICENSE file; the grant is evidenced from the GitHub repository
The 1B scale ceiling limits harder reasoning and coding tasks
